summary: Resubmitted as a repair (repair_of 6374186cdb5b4d49b1371f38c0b5ec70) of the previously rejected operation; the earlier rejection was a final-response formatting problem, not a draft problem. The draft is an obligation submission registering the sourced claim claim-config-publish-requires-durable-append (concern consensus_safety): for a leader handling a membership change, the resulting configuration must not be installed as configurations.latest, nor change the quorum derived from latest (commitment match indexes, quorumSize, leader-lease and election voter sets), unless the corresponding entry was durably appended to the log. Bindings anchor appendConfigurationEntry (raft.go:1203-1240), dispatchLogs (raft.go:1244-1283), quorumSize (raft.go:1086-1094) and commitment.setConfiguration (commitment.go:53-64); the claim grounding also cites the configurations doc comment (configuration.go:254-265) and the runFollower election gate (raft.go:205-240). The retained clean-copy execution from exploration 19c98425e4d9482cadcf9bfa3e4f7a85 supplied one transient LogStore.StoreLogs failure on a single-voter cluster that had committed index 3 and observed the assigned index 4 absent from durable storage (durable last index 3, raft last index 3) while the published configuration listed a phantom second voter, after which the node never regained leadership (142 samples, state Candidate, quorum 2, reachable voters 1), so progress stops pending restart. Scope records that a StoreLogs error is an admitted handled input (dispatchLogs responds the error and steps down), excludes corruption semantics beyond a returned error, and carries the unresolved and pending items (no-error reachability, exact failure timings, restart recovery path).
